what_this_is: The advertised pergola and veranda prices shown in the 'What pergolas and verandas cost in Ireland' section of DISC-035 The Outdoor Room. Each row is one price as the business published it on its own website, with what the business says it includes, the source page and the date PlotNua read it. Read-only evidence for atlas-tools/prove-disc035-page.py (O19), which proves the section shows exactly these rows and nothing else. Method mirrors garden-room-prices-ireland.html: advertised prices only, never quotes; nothing estimated, averaged or inferred; fields the business does not state are recorded as not stated.

method.rule: A price is listed only when it is read from the business's own published page and recorded with its check date. Three prices from two businesses are too few for an average, a median or a typical range, so the section shows the individual prices only.

recheck.reason: The 27 Nov 2026 build session could not reach superiorpergola.ie or outdoor.ie (network allowlist). The rows keep the 4 Nov 2026 check date under which they were first published on this page and on suppliers/superior-pergola-ireland.html; they are not re-dated.
recheck.next_action: Re-read both source pages and either confirm (update checked) or correct each row before 3 Jan 2027 (60 days after the check date).
